newsitem.title: USA: NYMEX ACCESS crudes edge up after API report.
newsitem.headline: NYMEX ACCESS crudes edge up after API report.

text.p: NYMEX ACCESS crude oil prices edged up in overnight trade, following a report from the American Petroleum Institute (API) on Tuesday, which indicated a jump in refinery use.

NYMEX May crude traded $21.06, up seven cents a barrel from Monday, as 1,069 lots traded overall and 653 in the front month. Traders said crude volume was light, with only a few hundred lots changing hands after the API report.
Refinery utilization jumped 2.3 percentage points to 92.7 percent of nationwide capacity.
NYMEX April heating oil fell 0.28 cent a gallon overnight to 56.55, amid volume of 105 lots, traders said.
Players with short positions were squeezed, buying ahead of Monday's contract expiry, pressuring the discount between April and May wider.
Gasoline was bought at 66.40 cents, down 0.12 cents as 38 lots changed hands in April, traders said.
